Product Features

  • Perfect dimensions: 180 x 35 x 49 cm, ideal for TVs up to 80 inches. The length and height harmonize perfectly with the style of your living room, making this TV stand the ideal addition.
  • Design: The successful combination of natural wood and black elements, along with round and semicircular graphics, sets it apart from conventional TV cabinets. Placed in the living room, it is not only a practical piece of furniture but also a design highlight that underlines your personality.
  • Thoughtful storage design: The interior of the three cabinets is clearly organized. Two open shelves in the middle offer space for various small items. This well-organized storage ensures a tidy living room.
  • Stable and robust: Seven evenly spaced PVC feet ensure the TV cabinet's load-bearing capacity. The recommended maximum load is 45 kg. Televisions, stereo systems, decorations, and other items can be placed on it safely and without worry.
  • Practical materials: Made from particleboard, this piece of furniture is sturdy and durable. The natural wood grain looks realistic, and the black cabinet doors add an elegant touch. Aesthetics and functionality combined – a long-lasting choice for your home.
  • Thoughtful details: Open shelves allow easy access to your items; the staggered arrangement provides space for items of different sizes, and the dampened hinges emphasize the design and demonstrate careful workmanship down to the smallest detail.
  • Stylish harmony: The color combination of wood and black exudes an elegant, artistic atmosphere, while the unique design of the cabinet doors perfectly complements various interior styles, including modern and industrial, adding a touch of style to your living room.
  • Versatile use: It can be used as a TV stand and storage cabinet in the living room or home theater for storing equipment. Versatile, extremely practical, and space-saving.
  • Integrated functionality: This TV stand combines storage space (multiple cabinet compartments), decoration (contrasting color design) and stability (TV + decoration), thus fulfilling diverse needs in the living room and increasing your quality of life.
  • Note: Due to varying shooting conditions and display devices, slight color variations may occur between the actual product and the image. This is normal and not a quality defect. We strive to represent the product color as accurately as possible. Please only order if you have any concerns regarding this.
